[Critique Rubric › Aggregating verdict] `tools/validate_critique.py` enforces exactly this table, so a critique that disagrees with
it fails rather than shipping. Earlier versions of this file counted hard fails and called

ubicaciones.encabezado: Critique Rubric › Aggregating verdict

Antecedente: la regla de tres majors decía "escalate to REJECT at your discretion" mientras el rubric contaba hard fails y llamaba REJECT a 3+ ("three hard fails a REJECT outright"); esas dos reglas se contradecían, "Discretion in a gate is not a gate", y esa discrepancia es la razón de que el umbral sea ahora un número.

[Visual Asset Critic › Handoff] If the verdict is REJECT, do not offer that. REJECT means a blocking issue or three or more
major ones, which is a failure with no clear fix path, and revision mode is built to stop
there and ask. Say what blocked it and what decision it needs: a changed shot spec, a
changed brand-lock, or a different generator.

ubicaciones.encabezado: Visual Asset Critic › Handoff

originales.texto:
[Visual Prompt Forge › Revision mode (closing the QA loop) › Workflow] 3. **Stop on `REJECT`.** A REJECT means the critic found a blocking issue, or three or more
   major ones: a failure with no clear fix path. Re-emitting a prompt for it pretends
   otherwise. List the rejected shots, say what the critic said about them, and ask the
   user how to proceed. Common answers are a change to the shot spec, a change to the
   brand-lock, or a different generator, and all three are decisions above this skill's
   pay grade.

ubicaciones.encabezado: Visual Prompt Forge › Revision mode (closing the QA loop) › Workflow

grupos.fusionado: Veredicto REJECT (visual-asset-critic › Handoff; visual-prompt-forge › Revision mode, paso 3 "Stop on `REJECT`"): REJECT significa un issue blocking o tres o más major, es decir un fallo sin fix path claro. En el handoff del critic no se ofrece el modo revisión; en forge, revision mode se detiene ahí: re-emitir un prompt para ese shot finge lo contrario. Listar los shots rechazados, decir qué los bloqueó y qué dijo el critic de ellos, y preguntar al usuario cómo proceder, nombrando la decisión que se necesita: un cambio en el shot spec, un cambio en el brand-lock o un generador distinto; las tres son decisiones por encima del alcance de este skill.
